spans.text: I am truly honored to be able to face you on the battlefield...
And then, to personally trample you underfoot.
Granted, Sangvis Ferri's situation is not looking very bright at the moment, and those military units are rampaging throughout our home.
However, my Mistress feels that your forces and your own performance for the past two years are too much of an eyesore.
Therefore, at this very moment, in order to fulfil my Mistress' wish...
Do allow me to bury you with my very own hands!
Take orders! Your target is every member of Griffin! Crush them!
